title: Walk between the lands
changes: Ten border roads now join all six lands on foot: follow a road out to the edge of a land and walk on into the mist of the pass to come out in the next one.
A road into a land opens at the same level as that land's gates, and the way back to Oakvale is always open.
The roads are marked on the world map with the land they lead to. The gates and portal stones still work as quick ways.
